title: The Unreliable Progress Bar: Can LLM Agents Reliably Report Task Progress Throughout Execution?
abstract: arXiv:2609.08589v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Recent large language models can emit task-progress signals that agent frameworks use to decide whether a task should continue or stop, yet whether a model can reliably report its task progress at every stage of a task, and where and how its reports fail, has not been studied systematically. We evaluate this ability on the public benchmark $\tau^2$-bench and on StageIF, a controlled testbed in which reporting checkpoints are placed across the task's lifecycle. Both settings require reports at multiple task stages. We find that reporting reliability depends on the stage a task has reached, and that almost every deployed model we test is reliable at some stages and unreliable at others. Where reporting breaks down is not the same everywhere. Most deployed models lose accuracy once work is under way and recover once the task is done. translated_title: 不可靠的进度条：大语言模型智能体能在整个执行过程中可靠地报告任务进度吗？
translated_abstract: 近期的大语言模型能够发出任务进度信号，智能体框架利用这些信号来决定任务是继续还是停止，然而模型能否在任务的每个阶段可靠地报告其进度，以及其报告在何处、以何种方式失效，尚未得到系统研究。我们在公开基准τ²-bench以及StageIF（一个在任务生命周期各阶段设置报告检查点的受控测试平台）上评估了这一能力，两种设置均要求在多个任务阶段进行报告。我们发现，报告的可靠性取决于任务所处的阶段，我们测试的几乎所有已部署模型在某些阶段可靠，而在另一些阶段不可靠。报告失效的位置并非处处相同：大多数已部署模型在工作进行中时丧失准确性，而在任务完成后恢复准确性；最新一代模型则消除了任务中途的准确性下降，反而在临近完成时变得保守。
tldr: 研究系统评估了LLM智能体在任务各阶段报告进度的可靠性，发现几乎所有已部署模型都存在阶段性失准——多数模型在任务中途失去准确性、完成后恢复，而最新一代模型虽消除了中途下降，却在临近完成时变得过于保守。
en_tdlr: LLM agents' ability to reliably report task progress depends on the task stage: most deployed models lose accuracy mid-task and recover at completion, while the newest generation eliminates this mid-task drop but instead becomes conservative near the finish line.
